A '''Rhydonium mining installation''' was constructed on the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] and controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="MIA" /> It was used mainly for mining [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]], a volatile [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] used by the CIS for stocking on a [[Renown/Legends|stolen Republic ship]] so as to destroy the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|Valor Station]], a space station located in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] that was hosting a [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]].<ref name="MIA" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad's]] [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|ship]] crash-landed on Abafar,<ref name="A Sunny Day">{{TCW|A Sunny Day in the Void}}</ref> and later, with the help of a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] named [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], who suffered from [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]], they [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|managed]] to steal a heavily guarded ship from the facility, and return the [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which they got from [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|their previous mission]].<ref name="SW">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref>
